description: This Java class defines a NotificationService within a learning management system backend, used for managing user notifications through server-sent events and messaging templates, including sending notifications, managing emitters, and retrieving recent notifications.

classes.name: NotificationService
classes.description: A Spring Service class responsible for handling user notifications in the LMS system.

methods.name: notifyUser
methods.description: Creates a new notification for a user, sends it via messaging template and Server-Sent Events emitter if active.

methods.name: notifyCourseInstructors
methods.description: Notifies all instructors enrolled in a specific course about an event or message.

methods.name: notifyCourseEnrolled
methods.description: Notifies all users enrolled in a specific course.

methods.name: recent
methods.description: Retrieves the 50 most recent notifications for a user.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates and registers a new SseEmitter for server-sent events to a user, allowing real-time notifications.
